title: Text gets a place on the homepage
summary:
Text became more visible across Pollinations, while model choices, referral links, project browsing, and site previews got a careful tune-up.

The homepage gained a switch between image and text feeds, plus an editor beside a stream of generated responses. Projects also gained a Featured category and browsing tabs, making more of what people build easier to find.

Llama 4 Scout 17B was added as `llamascout` with a 4096-token output limit. Several existing names were remapped: `mistral` to Mistral Small 3.1 24B, `qwen-qwq` to QWQ 32B, and `deepseek-reasoning` to DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 32B. The duplicate `qwen-reasoning` mapping was removed, and Gemini entries were commented out.

Eligible streamed chat responses gained the same opt-in ad processing as non-streamed responses, with links appended at the end of a stream. Across the week, referral matching was adjusted to consider prompts and generated text, while trigger words and fallback offers shifted from guaranteed placements toward probabilistic selection. Without the `p-ads` marker, the default referral-link probability remains 0%.

Goalani, a voice-enabled fitness coach, and DominiSigns, which translates text and audio into Dominican Sign Language with a 3D avatar, joined the project lists. The new Featured category and browsing tabs give projects a clearer path through the homepage, too.
